title: amorpha fruticosa f. humilis
intro: Amorpha fruticosa f. humilis, commonly known as Dwarf American Sallow or Low Sallow, is a shrubby perennial plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Amorpha fruticosa f. humilis include wound healing, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular protection, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
